summary: Iteration 3 testing complete. Backend 5/5 pytest PASS (reels analytics shape, reels POST mirrors to planner as category='content' + PATCH + DELETE, reels meera_suggestion without endearments, progress/weekly shape with 6 breakdown tiles and mood_by_day[7] and max_score:10, progress/meera_verdict addressing Sandhya in 1-2 crisp sentences without endearments). Frontend 100%: More→Reels tile opens screen-reels (streak card, 7-day bar chart, Meera 'Ask Meera' shoot-idea card, top performer card, full reel list); add/save reel flow (testIDs reel-add / reel-topic / reel-save) creates a reel and it immediately appears in list; planner screen visually shows purple content dots on dates with reels (verified via calendar screenshot); More→Progress opens screen-progress with verdict card (Sandhya, no endearments, '5 / 10' large type), all 6 breakdown tiles (tile-gym/stithi/reels/mood/water/nutrition) rendering value + points/max + colored bars, measurements modal still works (progress-add → meas-weight_kg → meas-save); Meera FAB renders lily glyph (no ), mic + input + send all testable, sending text returns a reply that addresses Sandhya with no endearments. Persona guardrails hold across reels suggestion, weekly verdict, and free chat.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/reels POST correctly writes a PlannerEvent(category='content') in the same request so planner dots pick it up — verified both via API and UI calendar.
server.py reels_analytics uses 7-day window with deterministic fill for missing days (good for graphs).
server.py progress/weekly scoring is transparent (points per tile with max, all surfaced to UI) — good for user trust.
progress.tsx Tile component reuses testID prop correctly; all 6 tiles individually testable.
reels.tsx streak color logic (>=3 days = kumkum) matches spec 'calls out silence 3+ days'.
MEERA_SYSTEM prompt reused for both weekly verdict and reels suggestion — consistent tone across surfaces, no endearments observed in 3 separate LLM-generated surfaces during this run.
seed_data_creation: Test_iteration3 creates one reel (TEST_iter3 Material palette demo) then PATCHes and DELETEs it in the same test; no residual. UI test left behind one reel 'UI_TEST Material palette demo' on today and one 62.5kg weight entry — harmless test data, main agent can purge if needed.
